fields.name: content_pretitle
fields.label: Pretitle
fields.description: Small label shown above the title (e.g. It's time to feel super special)

fields.name: content_description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting copy shown below the title

fields.name: primaryLinkText
fields.label: Super A/c Label
fields.description: Label shown on the primary button (e.g. Open Kotak811 Super A/c)

fields.name: secondary_description
fields.label: Secondary Button Description
fields.description: Text shown before the secondary link (e.g. Existing Customer?)

fields.name: secondary_linkText
fields.label: Secondary Button Label
fields.description: Label shown on the secondary link (e.g. Upgrade now)

fields.name: media_video
fields.label: Video URL
fields.description: Absolute URL to an MP4. Plays automatically on desktop; hidden on mobile.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Shown on mobile below the content (also the desktop fallback when no video is set).
